note: Illinois DNR recreation area on the west shore of Carlyle Lake, north of Carlyle. The Illini Campground runs along about 1.5 miles of shoreline; only sites 1-65 and 93 take reservations, the rest are first-come through the campground hosts. The lakeside sites face riprap. Pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day) behind the campground store; 36 walk-in tent sites and lakeshore cottages as well. --Claude
